caption: The drawing depicts a lidded vessel, possibly a tankard or stein, rendered in shades of gray on a tan or aged parchment-colored background. The central and largest image features the vessel from the front, showing a round base, a wide, curved body that narrows at the top before flaring out slightly at the lid, and a domed lid with a decorative loop handle on top. The surface of the vessel has ornate, symmetrical engraving that forms a decorative frame surrounding an oval medallion depicting a scene with two standing human figures and foliage, with additional scrollwork and a motif resembling a stag's head above the central medallion. In the top left corner, there is an inset outline sketch of the vessel in profile, displaying a prominent handle and the lid's form. In the lower right, there is another inset sketch showing the vessel from the rear, highlighting the handle and a corresponding top-view diagram of the handle shape. The drawing appears to be executed in pencil or fine ink lines, with shading used to give the central vessel a metallic or reflective appearance, and all components are contained within lightly rendered rectangular borders.
title: Silver Tankard
